summary: The Novo Nordisk Foundation's Mads Øvlisen Postdoc Fellowships 2027 support postdoctoral projects carried out mainly in Denmark with a Danish host institution. They are open to researchers with a PhD or an equivalent research qualification, with no limit on the number of years since the PhD. The call opens 30 October 2026 and closes 14 January 2027 at 14:00 Copenhagen time; results are announced in May 2027.
highlights: PhD or equivalent research qualification; no limit on years since the PhD.
Hosting letter required from a Danish university, museum or knowledge institution.
Applicants living outside Denmark must show that more than 50% of the project will be conducted in Denmark.
If the thesis is not approved by the deadline, a supervisor's statement is due by 29 March 2027.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Novo Nordisk Foundation page before applying.
